description:
**This is only for VIT Vellore Students.** 

VITMAS brings to you Cognition 2026, our flagship hackathon is back after a hiatus and its gonna be bigger and better this time around. The 36 hour event aims to boost innovation and collaboration.
Join us for a transformative experience where bright minds get to tackle real world challenges across AI/ML, Agentic AI, FinTech-Blockchain. Win exciting cashprize!

sponsors.about: Zuntra is a multidisciplinary innovation company building the future through AI, automation, robotics, design, and cultural intelligence — where creativity meets computation. Headquartered in Chennai (South Asia HQ) with a presence in Brooklyn, New York (North America), Zuntra helps enterprises, startups, universities, and government organizations accelerate growth through enterprise AI solutions, software engineering services, startup incubation programs, and innovation ecosystem development. The company operates across three core pillars: Enterprise AI Systems & Solutions, Software & Product Development, and Digital Transformation & Innovation Ecosystems — combining intelligent automation, digital product development, and venture-building expertise to create scalable technology solutions and future-ready organizations.
